origin.release: https://github.com/woct0rdho/SageAttention/releases (the build for torch 2.8.0 + cu128; post4-post6 need torch >= 2.9)
origin.downloaded: 2026-10-15, sha256 equal to the release asset's digest

what_for: The flows' full self-attention (one sequence, 12 heads x 128, bf16) through int8 Q.K^T and fp16 P.V kernels: pixal3d/modules/sage.py, switch PIXAL3D_SAGE (on by default after a first-use self-check; off = flash_attn, bit for bit as before). Measured on an RTX 3060: an hr / tex pass at 1536 -26 %, a five-prop batch -20 %, the allocated memory peak of a pass unchanged.

_qattn_sm80.pyd.note: runs on every sm_8x card (RTX 30xx / 40xx, A100): the kernel the fork uses there

_qattn_sm89.pyd.note: fp8 kernels, not used by the fork

_qattn_sm90.pyd.note: not used by the fork: sm_90+ runs the package's Triton kernel

declared_dependencies: none in the wheel's METADATA (needs torch 2.8.x+cu128 and, for sm_90+, triton-windows, both installed in Pixal3D's venv)

runtime_requirements.install: pip install <this wheel>  (Pixal3D's install.py installs every wheel in its whl folder)
runtime_requirements.cards: sm_80 and newer; below that pixal3d/modules/sage.py refuses it and the flows keep their attention backend

known_issue_of_this_build: post6 upstream fixed stale shared memory for key rows past the sequence end; in this build it only matters for sequences of 64 keys or fewer, which the fork never hands to it (sage.MIN_TOKENS 65)
measurements: code/logs/profiling/pixal3d-lowmem/round-g/sage/REPORT.md and round-g/sage-full, sage-7g (Spellcast3D hub, git-ignored); scripts in code/devtools/pixal3d-lowmem/round-g/sage/
